Edit handles

Definition

Edit handles is extra source frames supplied before and after a used range so finishing work can adjust transitions safely. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align post decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
